item.title: Love Is A Many-Splendored Thing
item.description: A widowed doctor of both Chinese and European descent falls in love with a married American correspondent in Hong Kong during China's Communist Revolution.

item.title: House
item.description: A horror novelist inherits a mysterious home where he's forced to confront his past.

item.title: Fright Night
item.description: When a vampire moves next door to teenager Charlie Brewster, he enlists the help of an incredulous TV horror movie host to prevent a massive killing spree.

item.title: Young Frankenstein
item.description: After inheriting the Frankenstein Castle, a doctor, who has tried all his life to distance himself from his notorious relative, finds himself drawn to the unfinished work.

item.title: Short MOVIES!
item.description: A parody of Casablanca. , Yosemite Sam is working as a king's chef when he is asked to prepare a dish made from rabbit. When Bugs Bunny comes over to borrow carrots, Sam decides that Bugs would be perfect for the recipe.

item.title: The Adventures of Young Indiana Jones
item.description: Indy's Belgian Army unit goes to face fortified German positions in the Battle of the Somme. Then, Indy is sent to a German prison camp.

item.title: Short MOVIES!
item.description: A parody of Disney's Fantasia set in "Corny-Gee Hall". We watch Elmer Fudd, and Bugs Bunny act out a play from "A Tale of Vienna Woods". , Sam holds-up a train and challenges Bugs to draw a gun.

item.title: Sherlock Holmes and the Scarlet Claw
item.description: When a gentlewoman is found dead with her throat torn out, the villagers blame a supernatural monster, but Sherlock Holmes, who gets drawn into the case from nearby Quebec, suspects a human murderer.

item.title: Blondie
item.description: Blondie schemes to save a friendly resort hotel from bankruptcy.

item.title: Laurel and Hardy
item.description: Two love-sick fellows join the French Foreign Legion., Ollie is running for mayor when an old flame tries to blackmail him.
